dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_apothecary.b:
A brewing stand is far too heavy for a traveller's pack. Get your potions here.
Once you reach the fire chapter, I'll have something put aside for you.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_apothecary.i: The apothecary. Healing, antidotes, night sight, fire ward. Get your travelling potions here.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_apothecary.l:
If you're going to the fire lands, take one of each. Fire ward and healing.
Buy any more from the shelf. Two fire wards would be safer.
Fire ward for the heat of the ash lands, healing for wounds. ...Both are on the shelf. Two fire wards if you're entering the forge.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_apothecary.m: Ask about preparing for the fire lands
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_black_market: ...Looking is free. The goods change each day. Payment in coin, and in titan shards.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_drunkard.aby: The abyss, the abyss. After the four hearts stop, the bottom opens its mouth... my old man said so. Hic.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_drunkard.int: Hic... did you know there's another sky beneath the sky?
At night I see someone standing on the graves. Watching. ...I hope it's only my eyes.
I keep the graves. The nameless ones keep growing. Even I don't know who sleeps in them.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_guide.colors: The colour tells you the kind of place. Gold is for buying and storing, blue for resting and setting out, red for training and fighting, violet for stories and prayer. Grey is the back streets. The lanterns go out when you arrive, and if you pick somewhere else, they move there.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_guide.gates: There are four gates: the Whale Gate to the north, the Tide Gate east, the Ash Gate south and the Wind Gate west. One of us guides stands at each, and another by the fountain in the plaza. If you get lost, look for the nearest white cloak.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_guide.intro: Welcome to the Bell Capital. It's a big city. Tell me where you want to go, and I'll light the way to the door at your feet.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_guide.menu.w: Pick a destination (lanterns show the way)
Welcome to the Whale Chasers' Guild. You can found a guild here, or apply to join one. The message board's errands are here too.
Guild desk (found, join, requests, banner, deeds)

A guild is a fellowship travellers make themselves. Pick banner colours, a pattern and a name, and up to thirty may join. Its tag shows on your name plate. Members share a storehouse and take on a weekly request together. Finish enough requests and special patterns and tag colours open up. The leader can't leave: hand over leadership or disband first.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_innkeeper.in: Welcome to the Bell Inn. Take a bed, and if you fall, you'll wake here. As for rumours, I have plenty.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_innkeeper.me: If you're waiting for companions, use the common room. Your party cards will tell you where everyone is.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_perch_keeper:
I keep the travellers' things. If you've met a titan, I can call its young from the perch; choose where to go on the chart.
I also keep beasts that carry load and rider from town to town. Take a whistle; blow it and your mount comes, wherever you are.
The young won't answer for a sleeping titan. A party of up to six can ride together. When you get off, it melts back into song.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_shrine_pries: This is the Shrine of the Four Titans. Here are the altar of rebirth, and the key chamber where sky-key fragments are laid.

The four stones are the seats of the four titans. Touch the stone of a titan whose heart you stilled, and one sky-key fragment rests in it. When four rest here, the key takes shape. Laid fragments are never lost, and I'll return them any time.
How may I help?
What is this place?
I'll come again
About the key chamber
Lay fragments in the key chamber
About rebirth
Take back the laid fragments
About vows (bindings for repeat runs)
The altar at the back is the altar of rebirth. Past level 50, with five resonance crystals to offer, touch it to let go of what you built and walk again. In return, something stays with your soul.

A vow is a binding for repeat runs. By the shrine of a titan whose heart you have stilled, before you ride, you may swear up to three. The heavier the vows, the more materials, the likelier resonance shards, and a title besides. Which vow would you hear of?
Back
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.forge: Put the piece in the forge. Strengthening takes resonance shards; breaking down takes the piece itself. Reforging depends on materials. Try one step at a time.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.intro: This is the smithy. The resonance forge in the back strengthens, breaks down and reforges. Here I mend worn gear for coin.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.menu.f: How do I use the forge?
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.menu.r: Mend the item in hand (bell coins)
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_storage_keep: This is the storehouse. What you leave here can be taken out at any storehouse, in any town. Keep your satchel's precious things in the satchel.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_tool_merchan: Tools and supplies. Light, rope, bedrolls, maps and boats. Food is next door at the food vendor, weapons at the outfitter.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_trade_keeper: This is the exchange. Travellers trade with each other here. I hold what you put up, and if you write what you want, someone will apply.

What you list, I hold from the moment you list it. Ask for goods or bell coins, as you like. Applying moves nothing. The moment the seller accepts, both sides swap at once, as long as the applicant still has the goods and room to carry. An absent applicant can't be accepted. Ten listings each; after seven days the goods come back to you, waiting in your mailbox. If you're away when someone answers, I'll tell you next time.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_training_mas: Strike a straw dummy and the damage floats above its head. I'll tell you the five-second total and the rate per second too. Skills and arrows count.
This is the training yard. Hit the dummy and it shows the damage. I also handle skill resets and job changes, so you need not walk to the forge.
A reset returns every node taken in your current job's tree (other jobs' trees stay). The price is resonance crystals, or bell coins if you have none (thirty per crystal). Free until Lv 15.

The job hall is in the back. You can change to any of the six jobs. Each job keeps its own tree, and a first-time job gets its starter weapon. Swapping weapons alone does not change your job; to use skills, hold that job's weapon.

message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch1.1: They say the stone whale in the north opens its eyes a little whenever the chains ring.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch1.2: Someone counts bones at night, out past the graveyard.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch1.3: An apprentice of the Whale Chasers' Guild twisted an ankle on the first climb. Mind the cliff ropes.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch2.1: On low-tide days, they say a road shows on the sea floor.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch2.2: A fisher netted an eye the size of a pearl. Gives me the creeps.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch2.3: On the east shore, shells rang all night long.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch3.1: On thunder nights, keep the children inside, they say.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch3.2: The feathers from the western sky don't burn, even when they fall.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch3.3: A traveller wrapped in copper wire is said to have called down lightning.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch4.1: The ash in the south is still warm, they say.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch4.2: The smith's apprentice was raving about threads of fire.
message.skyabyss.inn.rumor.ch4.3: The drunkard says the bottom opens once the fourth heart stops.

dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_innkeeper.in: Welcome to the inn. Take a bed and this is where you wake if you fall. And I have rumours to spare.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_shrine_pries: A branch shrine of the Four Titans. You can offer the sky key's shards here too.
Shards left here are carved into the four stones of the capital's shrine. When all four are set, the key takes shape. Nothing you leave is lost, and I return them whenever you ask.
The rebirth altar stands at the back of the capital's shrine. Past Lv 50, with five resonance crystals offered, touch it to walk the road again.
Food here. Hardtack, bread, dried fish and the dishes of the lands. Nobody climbs a titan on an empty stomach.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_outfitter.in: Outfitter. Swords, shields, armour, arrows. Whetstones too. ...You are the one swinging it, so pick what fits.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_material_tra: Materials. Iron, copper, charcoal, resonance shards and socket shards. I buy titan materials too. My eye does not lie.
message.skyabyss.runs.title: - Back-run records -
message.skyabyss.runs.week_none: No guild has stopped a heart this week yet
message.skyabyss.runs.ranked: You made the run records (#%1$s, %2$s). The guild clerk can show you the board
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_box_opener.i: Brought me a sealed box? What a foe drops stays asleep until the seal is cut. I'll cut it for you, no charge. I like the sound a seal makes.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_box_opener.m: ...A box? I like the smell of sealing wax more than the capital's bells.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_box_opener.r: Boxes from a titan's back bear that titan's mark, and hold only its gear. The others show their rank by colour: green, blue, purple, vermilion. The band number is the Lv range inside. The gold box comes from the bottom of the abyss. Boxes of the same kind stack.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_box_opener.m: ...A box? Whalebone clasps are stubborn. A small knife pries them best.
...A box? The tide's dampened the seal. Let it dry a moment before I cut.
...A box? On windy days the seals hum all by themselves.
...A box? Burn it with an ember and the seal opens without a sound.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_shrine_pries: About the former watcher's page
About the former watcher's page
About the former watcher's page
The shrine keeps a page left by a former sky-watcher. ...Not yet. When the third titan's tale stirs, then.

The page a former sky-watcher left. If you go to the third titan, you have the right to read it. Take it.
The hand may look familiar. A hand from before rebirth is not easily forgotten.
I gave you the page already. If you read it, it is in your book. ...If not, hurry. The storm will not wait.

dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_perch_keeper: Blow once and it comes; blow again and it goes home. It can't follow you onto a titan's back, down into the abyss, or into a heart chamber. It also leaves if you wander far or log off. New looks arrive as you clear chapters; stats you polish with bell coins.
See or buy mounts (looks and stats)
